_source: Approved rows from src/data/reviews.json, copied verbatim (every field unchanged). match: programme = left on this course's own feedback form; text-mention = left on another LevelUp form but the text names this course; related = another LevelUp programme in the same craft. Picked 17 Oct 2026 so no review appears on two masterclass pages.

reviews.name: Kavyansh M.
reviews.role: I'm a 3rd year psychology student and I write stories , crea
reviews.text:
From the begining I always wanted to create a short film on my and I've written few of them on my own but neither of them is structured but after this workshop I've a clear vision what I wanna write and how to do it.
Thank you so much level up for this amazing workshop.

reviews.name: Vaaishnav
reviews.text: I am trying to write my first script,with this workshop I have gotten a great idea of what I was missing from my scripts.thank you for that,the workshop was wonderful

reviews.name: Amogh V.
reviews.role: I am currently pursuing my Engineering degree
reviews.text:
Sure willing to share my experience to everyone. Guys take my words, just after 2 hours of the direction session, I started seeing cinema in proper filmy way. No joke. At first i thought that 2 hour isn't enough, but 2 hours was much more enough than I expected. Please join and enjoy the worldly cinema and please understand the film in actually way. 
Thank you.

reviews.name: Madhav
reviews.text: Like I just write script without the camera movements and angles and today I just got to know how to add and how to say story with camera movements and angles

reviews.name: Naji O.
reviews.text:
Hi, The session was too good, that I really enjoyed and cleared my all doubts about the direction. I am a Cinematographer worked in two Movies. So, I need to know about the direction techniques to my upcoming movies. So, it was a great to chance for me. 
Thank you.

reviews.name: Sandeep N.
reviews.text: After attending this 2 hours session, I have understood the concepts like conflict rising, stakes, arc of character, need & want and scene concept of enter late and exit early of script writing which are new knowledge for me.. Thank you very much

reviews.name: Sreelekha
reviews.text: I had many ideas to write but i always used to feel confused and overwhelmed about it . This course gave me a structure that helped me and made it easy for me to write a story it helped me to get a hold of something Everything was explained in engaging, intresting yet simple way

reviews.name: Elizabeth Z.
reviews.text: Everything was to the point and helped me to organize some ideas I already have. I used to follow my own format when I write but now I know what to work on and what to taper down. Looking forward to learn even more. Thanks so much!

reviews.name: Amrutha S.
reviews.text: Hey Team, I have the crave of doing atleast a short film. Since I am IT professional , I thought og giving up a lot time But you guys made me to start writing admist all of my busy schedules because a personal like me with no idea from where to start, how to start, your sessions made me atleast to take a first step. Thank you so much

reviews.name: Mukilan
reviews.text: I am glad I attended this workshop. Previously, while watching films, I would sense some kind of elements being repeated in similar scenes in other films that elevate the scene. Now, after learning the technical terms, it would be easier for me to understand the elements of a film.

reviews.name: Chethan R.
reviews.text: I have never watched a movie with the mindset taught over this session. It will change your perspective of watching cinema after this course. Highly recommended to all who have bitten by cinema bug!
